messages:
maria: Quick preflight — Monday release. Need final changelog link, docs URL, and a canary start time. Also want to lock webinar CTA text so marketing can schedule emails. @aj @noah :eyes:

aj: On changelog — PR is queued, I'll drop the public link by EOD. internal note: waiting on one small typo fix from eng-docs.

noah: Docs update is merged to staging. Public URL will be the stable docs path, but we need to run the redirect. Setting up a short-lived preview link: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/release-2026-03-30

maria: Perfect. Can we get the canonical docs link (not preview) by Monday 09:00 PT? Marketing sends the first mail at 10:00.

sara: We should ship a single-line CTA for the webinar: "See the new performance benchmarks and join our 4/7 webinar." Need final copy by 16:00 today to build the nurture flow.

aj: Changelog link (public): https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-03-release — still WIP until the typo is fixed. ETA 18:00 PT.

noah: Docs canonical will be https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03 once redirect is live. Ops will toggle the redirect at 08:30 PT on Monday. @ops-lead can you confirm?

ops-lead: Confirmed. We'll switch the redirect at 08:30 PT and monitor for 30m. Alert if 5xx > 0.5% during that window. deploy-bot will post status.

maria: Great. Canary timing — suggest 09:30 PT for a 1-hour canary (10% traffic) then ramp at 10:30. Any objections?

aj: 10% sounds fine. We'll have auto-fallback to the previous model if latency > 250ms p95 for 5 minutes. Adding that policy to the rollout config now. Sample snippet: ```json
{"rollout": "canary", "percent": 10, "slo_p95": 250}
```

noah: I'll add a note in the docs page about the canary and rollback plan.

maria: Can marketing get a final changelog + docs link + canary start time by 18:00 PT? If yes, we'll finalize the email and social posts. :thumbsup:

aj: Yes — changelog link by 18:00.

noah: Docs canonical live by Monday 08:30 PT.

sara: I'll draft the webinar CTA and email copy and drop it here at 15:30 for quick review.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] redirect-toggle job queued for 2026-03-30T15:30:00Z, monitoring enabled.

maria: Thanks all — picking up at 15:30 for copy review. If anything slips, ping this thread. :rocket:
